result.summary: Updates CI linting tools and container base dependencies to newer versions. Bumps uv to 0.13, ruff to 0.17, mypy to 2.4.0, and markdown-link-check (MLC) to 1.3.0.
result.problem: CI linters and tool versions become outdated over time, missing upstream checks, bug fixes, and performance improvements.
evidence: Commit messages specify version updates across lint CI files: uv 0.13, ruff 0.17, mypy 2.4.0, MLC 1.3.0.
result.changed_since_previous: No changes to the patch content or approach; concrete patch diff provided.
result.card: Updates continuous integration linting dependencies by bumping uv, ruff, mypy, and markdown-link-check to newer releases. This keeps CI lint tooling current with upstream improvements and bug fixes. It carries low risk and affects only CI configuration files.

risk.why: A faulty tool update could cause linting jobs in CI to fail or report false positives, but it does not affect node binaries or release code.
